title: Active paired zone shift
statement: Let $\ell$ be a natural number, let $i+1<\ell$, and let $z$ be zone contents for $\ell$ zones. Suppose the right word in zone $i$ is empty, the left word in zone $i$ has length equal to its capacity, and the left word in zone $i+1$ has length plus $2^i$ at most its capacity. After the paired shift at zone $i+1$, the right word in zone $i$ is the first $2^i$ symbols of the original right word in zone $i+1$, the left word in zone $i$ is the first $2^i$ symbols of the original left word in zone $i$, the right word in zone $i+1$ is the remainder of the original right word there, and the left word in zone $i+1$ is the remainder of the original left word in zone $i$ followed by the original left word in zone $i+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $\ell$ is a natural number and $z$ consists of $\ell$ zones
The right word in zone $i$ is empty
The left word in zone $i$ has length equal to its capacity
The left word in zone $i+1$ has length plus $2^i$ at most its capacity
